copyStrategy: One quiet number-led caption per state, in a fixed lower slot, transforming in place: '48 teams' to '12 groups of 4' to '32 advance' to '104 matches. 1 champion.'
narrativeArc: A field of team dots fills the frame as 48 teams, settles into 12 groups of four, advances into a knockout ladder as it narrows to 32, then converges on a single lit champion beside the 104-match headline.
visualThesis: One field of team dots is the persistent world. It never resets; it re-forms. Each structural stage of the tournament is the same dots moving into a new formation, so the viewer literally watches 48 become 1.
